007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import java.util.Locale;
010
011/**
012 * Status values accepted when creating a Select AI Agent team.
013 *
014 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateTeamSample.html">
015 *      CreateTeamSample source</a>
016 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/LoadTeamSample.html">
017 *      LoadTeamSample source</a>
018 * @since 1.1.0
019 */
020public enum TeamStatus {
021    /** Team is enabled after creation. */
022    ENABLED("ENABLED"),
023    /** Team is disabled after creation. */
024    DISABLED("DISABLED");
025
026    /** Database status value. */
027    private final String value;
028
029    TeamStatus(String value) {
030        this.value = value;
031    }
032
033    /**
034     * Returns the database status value.
035     *
036     * @return database status value
037     */
038    public String getValue() {
039        return value;
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * Parses a database status value.
044     *
045     * @param value database status value; comparison is case-insensitive
046     * @return matching status, or {@code null} when the value is null or blank
047     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the value is not {@code ENABLED}
048     *                                  or {@code DISABLED}
049     */
050    public static TeamStatus fromValue(String value) {
051        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
052            return null;
053        }
054        return switch (value.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
055            case "ENABLED" -> ENABLED;
056            case "DISABLED" -> DISABLED;
057            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("status must be either ENABLED or DISABLED");
058        };
059    }
060}
